patch.value:
## Baseline and problem

The 2026-07-13 exhaustive live audit found 1,786 items, 1,601 parent edges, and 1,137 dependency entries. Parent plus dependency connectivity is complete through the roadmap root, but the active dependency-only graph has 109 weak components, 100 isolated items, and a longest prerequisite chain of only two edges. This means hierarchy is doing nearly all structural work while execution, provenance, and impact semantics remain under-modeled.

## Principles

- Model meaning, not density: no link exists merely to improve a graph metric.
- Separate hierarchy, order-bearing prerequisites, provenance, evidence, and associative relevance.
- Make edge kind, direction, inverse behavior, payload, authorship, time, source, and confidence explicit.
- Treat graph reads as bounded, cursorable, streamable SDK primitives; render token-efficient summaries by default.
- Evaluate cycles only on declared order-bearing edge kinds.
- Preserve immutable mutation history and permit point-in-time reconstruction.
- Scale from a seconds-long scratch project to million-item, multi-decade, thousand-agent ecosystems.
- Keep the CLI and MCP thin over the same public SDK capabilities.
- Backfill closed history only in deliberate changelog-safe batches; never fabricate metadata or dependencies.

## Delivery horizons

H1 establishes semantics, SDK registry and bounded traversal. H2 adds governance and active-lineage enrichment. H3 adds incremental analytics and context-engine signals. H4 reconstructs terminal history in resumable waves. H5 proves federated and million-item behavior and supports non-PM domains.
Project relationship graph maturity: typed edge ontology, graph governance, scalable analytics, and all-status knowledge-map backfill
Make item relationships first-class, semantically typed, queryable, explainable, and useful from tiny projects to million-item multi-agent ecosystems without manufacturing meaningless edges.

A reviewed ADR defines canonical and custom edge semantics, direction, ordering, inverse, provenance, and compatibility; The public SDK exposes bounded graph mutation and query primitives before thin CLI, MCP, and package adapters; Graph governance reports semantic errors, isolates, stale or redundant edges, cycles only over order-bearing kinds, and profile-aware coverage; Analytics provide explainable critical paths, blast radius, bottlenecks, communities, redundancy, and relevance signals with deterministic evidence; A resumable all-status backfill classifies every item as connected, intentional root or archive, waived, or remediation debt without synthetic related filler; Benchmarks demonstrate bounded memory, latency, and token output at one million items while preserving small-project ergonomics
Turn the complete tracker into a trustworthy typed knowledge graph that agents and algorithms can traverse under bounded time and token budgets
Every agent can recover why work exists, what it affects, what orders it, and which evidence supports it without dumping the tracker
Enables graph algorithms, context optimization, critical-path planning, dependency integrity, and durable ecosystem understanding at every scale
A schema-extensible relationship model, SDK graph primitives, scalable analytics, governance audits, and evidence-backed all-status enrichment
The live hierarchy is connected but the active dependency graph has 100 isolates and only a two-edge prerequisite depth; some documented prerequisites are not encoded

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text: Typed-edge census before and after the 2026-07-26 ladder pass, restricted to open items so no closed item was dragged into the current changelog bucket. Before: parent 1873, related 2089, blocked_by 364, blocks 69, discovered_from 57, implements 49, verifies 41, child 15, incident_from 1 — 4,558 edges over 2,051 nodes. After: parent 1878, related 2111, blocked_by 365, blocks 69, discovered_from 61, implements 286, verifies 91, child 15, incident_from 1 — 4,877 edges over 2,056 nodes. The point of the pass was not edge count but kind: related carried 46 percent of all edges and is traversable as a semantic relation by no graph subcommand, so the strategic structure was stored in the one kind that graph algorithms cannot read. Two ontology observations for this epic. First, pm graph predecessors/successors accept ordering kinds only (blocks, blocked_by) and ancestors/descendants accept hierarchy kinds only (parent, child); implements and verifies are rejected by all four with 'is not a ordering kind', so the semantic kinds this ontology introduced are reachable only through impact, dominators, centrality, communities and articulation. That asymmetry is worth an explicit disposition — either the traversal subcommands gain a semantic mode or the docs state that impact is the semantic traversal — because an agent reasonably expects predecessors to answer 'what implements this'. Second, the vocabulary is still fragmenting as pm-4020c5 describes: related_to appears 16 times beside related's 2,111, both meaning the same relation.

value.text:
Epic-level state change worth recording, because the graph this epic governs stopped being an active-only artefact today.

Before: 5,147 edges over 2,091 nodes, with the active subgraph reporting 0 isolates and 0 degree-at-most-one nodes while 1,024 of 1,795 terminal items had no outbound edge and 1,682 had no edge that semantic traversal accepts. The epic's own analytics, governance audit and conformance children were all measuring a 293-node slice of a 2,091-node graph.

After the terminal backfill: roughly 3,900 evidence-derived edges added across 1,713 terminal items, so the completed history of the project is now traversable. Consequences that land on this epic's children rather than on the backfill:

- pm-6olc95 (audit scoping) gets a clean confirmation: the audit reported all-clear at the exact moment 86 percent of the workspace was unmeasured.
- pm-3dyec2 (traversal verbs reject semantic kinds) gets a much larger blast radius: roughly 1,600 terminal items now carry typed lineage that ancestors and predecessors cannot see, measured at count 0 versus 1,444 on the same node.
- pm-bzmeaa (depth metrics) gets its terminal baseline and the per-class edge yields.
- pm-t2t709 is newly filed under this epic: the dependency traversal's token budget is enforced against a different representation than the one emitted, understating cost by about 2.8 times — which matters more now that edge density has risen.
- pm-1w6scp is newly filed: the thirteen duplicated v1 milestone epics and the parentless roots are a structural discontinuity that edge inference cannot fix, so no graph walk yet reaches the project's origin.

value.text:
Final measured state after the terminal backfill, 2026-07-26. Recording here because these are the numbers this epic's conformance and governance children should be built against.

Terminal items (1,797): items with no outbound edge fell from 1,024 to 47; items with no edge that semantic traversal accepts fell from 1,682 to 163; items with no edge in either direction fell from 822 to 9.

Whole-workspace connectivity, undirected over all statuses: one component spanning 2,058 of 2,097 nodes, which is 98.1 percent. Sixteen components remain, and the residual is the structural problem pm-1w6scp owns rather than an edge-inference shortfall.

Depth, which is the property that matters for the deep-linking requirement: maximum hop distance is 9 from pm-2xl, the oldest v1 milestone epic, reaching all 2,058 nodes; 8 from pm-t4d7nz, the furthest-horizon outcome milestone; and 8 from an arbitrary enriched closed item. So the graph is eight to nine levels deep end to end rather than the three to five it was, and a traversal from either temporal extreme of the project reaches the whole connected corpus.

Edge composition moved from 5,147 to 8,891: implements 317 to 1,932, related 2,260 to 4,360, with blocked_by, blocks, verifies, discovered_from, parent and child essentially unchanged. That composition is itself a caution for pm-hnc9w7 and pm-4020c5 — related is now 49 percent of all edges, so any kind-vocabulary work should treat related as the bucket that most needs refining into stronger kinds, not as a settled default.

value.author: harness:codex
value.text:
Graph quality and algorithm policy

The graph is a temporal, provenance-aware knowledge graph, not a target edge count. Canonical kinds distinguish hierarchy, implementation, prerequisite/blocking, verification/evidence, discovery/incident origin, supersession, release, package, and intentionally weak association. Each stored edge has direction, inverse semantics, source, author, confidence, valid-time or event-time where needed, and a correction/supersession path.

Quality metrics are semantic: reachability to outcomes, typed-path diversity, evidence coverage, uncertainty, stale-edge rate, execution-cycle freedom, redundant shortcut rate, boundary crossings, and bounded query cost. Parent depth is descriptive and must never be inflated. Complex understanding comes from multiple truthful typed paths over history, not arbitrary nesting.

Algorithms include dynamic reachability, topological scheduling over order-bearing kinds only, strongly connected components, dominators, articulation points, betweenness and flow bottlenecks, community detection, personalized PageRank, k-shortest explainable paths, temporal motif and recurrence analysis, link prediction that emits candidates rather than facts, and incremental summaries for context ranking. Every query supports kind filters, time bounds, max depth, result limit, token budget, cursor, and explanation receipts.

Terminal backfill is evidence-derived and epoch-batched. Ambiguous history remains explicit uncertainty; synthetic related edges are forbidden. The invariant is that every item is connected to the strategic map by a reviewable path while the original record and every correction remain replayable.

value.author: harness:codex
value.text: Typed-graph organization principle 2026-08-01: density is never the target. Each edge must answer one question: order with blocked_by or blocks, realization with implements, evidence with verifies, provenance with discovered_from or incident_from, evolution with supersedes, hierarchy with parent or child, and only genuinely associative context with related. Governance should measure typed path reachability to outcomes, semantic degree, depth, critical paths, dominators, articulation points, redundancy, uncertainty, provenance, and terminal versus active coverage. Automated reconstruction may propose edges from immutable history, linked files, releases, and incident evidence, but must retain source, confidence, and a reviewable dry-run; ambiguity becomes an investigation, never fabricated filler.
